cross_source_union_adds.statement: The aggregate places COD crystal records beside AFLOW and Materials Project computed structure records, exposing multiple source-qualified structural and phase candidates without treating formula identity as phase identity.

The same landscape includes 2D C2DB electronic context and bulk or three-dimensional electronic records from Materials Project and NOMAD, so the dimensionality, method, functional, and SOC context actually returned by those sources can be inspected before selecting exact follow-ups; direct, indirect, or optical gap modality remains a gap when the source does not declare it.

material_landscape.researcher_use: Use the cross-source landscape to separate 2D and bulk candidates and their calculation contexts, then inspect only the preregistered exact structures and Materials Project spectral artifacts needed for the declared comparison and plots.
material_landscape.external_handoff: A phase-resolved experiment-computation comparison or new many-body/DFT calculation requires separately identified experimental gap data and external electronic-structure workflows over phase-matched inputs.

rq3_method_applicability.reason: Two preregistered exact structures can enter one transparent StructureMatcher call, and complete exact MP band/DOS artifacts can each be rendered once without hidden retrieval or case logic inside MatRouter core.

scientific_question: What multi-source structural and electronic evidence is available for MoS2, with bulk/monolayer, phase, functional, SOC, directness, and calculation/experiment context kept distinct?

stage_2_targets.scientific_role: Preregistered 2D p-6m2 PBE+SOC source-summary band-gap and context record; C2DB exposes no band-structure or DOS artifact route for this record.

explicit_structure_method.interpretation_limit: A match states only that these two exact structures match under these parameters. It does not establish electronic, magnetic, or topological phase identity.

retrieval_strategy: RQ1 uses one aggregate_source_records call with bounded parallel cross-source execution (at most eight workers), stable-order aggregation, and fair sharing of the public 512-item/16-MB primary Bundle; its typed outcomes and completeness states are the route-accounting result, not an all-records landscape. RQ2 then runs one independent selected-source exhaust-upstream Evidence run and Bundle for every ready primary search_materials execution route in stable exact-route order, taking each record limit from begin_evidence_run.capacity.max_single_source_record_items while preserving the declared page, time, and byte ceilings. Shard records remain source-qualified and are never merged or deduplicated across routes. MaterialsGalaxy remains one provider-level execution route; child dataset identities are record provenance, not child outcomes. Exact follow-up still uses only the three preregistered targets and never substitutes records discovered by the shards.
context_differences: Formula identity does not establish bulk versus monolayer or a polytype.
Computed and experimental records, functionals, SOC settings, and direct/indirect gaps are not interchangeable.
A scalar band gap is not a band structure or density of states.
COD experimental crystal structures are structural evidence, not experimental band-gap observations.
allowed_statement: Describe this result as a capacity-bounded multi-source structural and electronic landscape. Report each source-qualified gap, structure, and exact spectral artifact only with the dimensional, phase, method, functional, SOC, directness, or modality context its source actually declares; do not infer a missing direct, indirect, or optical designation. State only that the preregistered AFLOW and Materials Project exact bulk structures match under the declared StructureMatcher parameters; this does not establish electronic, magnetic, or topological phase identity. An explicit spectral render is a derived view of the same exact artifact and adds no source evidence.
prohibited_statement: Do not report a universal MoS2 band gap or a phase-resolved MoS2 gap answer, merge records by formula, infer a shared 2H bulk, 1H monolayer, or other phase without explicit structure matching, count COD experimental structures as experimental band-gap observations, or treat retrieval/rendering as independent experimental validation.
missing_evidence: This run retrieved no band-gap observation explicitly identified as experimental; COD experimental structures do not supply an experimental band gap.
The returned band-gap observations do not declare direct, indirect, or optical modality; that context remains unresolved rather than inferred.

Only the preregistered AFLOW and Materials Project exact bulk structures enter one fixed-parameter match; phase equivalence remains unresolved for every other cross-source record, the 2D C2DB target, and different polytypes.
The result is a capacity-bounded multi-source material landscape, not a phase-resolved MoS2 gap answer.
Any calculation or phase context absent from a returned source-qualified record remains unknown.

The all-qualified aggregate attempts every parsed qualified route, but fair Bundle-capacity sharing or a safety ceiling can yield typed partial or truncated outcomes and prevents an all-upstream-records claim.
A missing parsed band/DOS artifact is not evidence that the source has no spectrum.
next_action: Any phase-resolved comparison beyond the one preregistered AFLOW-to-Materials-Project exact-structure match requires separately declared exact inputs; obtain separately identified experimental band-gap observations for an experiment-computation comparison and do not collapse this evidence to one MoS2 gap.
